cases.title: Principal AI Architect
cases.descriptionText: Own production AI system architecture, platform decisions, design authority, and LLM deployment patterns.
cases.reviewReason: Explicit AI architecture ownership and production authority.

cases.title: Applied AI Architect, Digital Natives
cases.descriptionText: Define AI architectural patterns, deploy OpenAI APIs, and build production prototypes, including building and presenting demos.
cases.reviewReason: Applied AI role has architecture and implementation authority; software building is not construction.

cases.title: Staff AI Engineer
cases.descriptionText: Lead production LLM system design, platform decisions, implementation standards, and technical direction.
cases.reviewReason: Adjacent engineering title with architecture-grade technical authority.

cases.title: Forward Deployed Architect
cases.descriptionText: Design and deliver production AI systems while owning customer architecture and implementation decisions.
cases.reviewReason: Forward-deployed title is eligible because duties own technical architecture and delivery.

cases.title: Head of AI Engineering
cases.descriptionText: Lead multiple AI engineering teams and own platform strategy, architecture standards, hiring, and technical roadmap.
cases.reviewReason: Multi-team leadership retains technical architecture ownership.

cases.title: Director of AI Platform
cases.descriptionText: Manage three platform teams and remain accountable for production AI architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction.
cases.reviewReason: Organizational scope and architecture accountability support progression.

cases.title: AI Customer Engineer
cases.descriptionText: Design customer AI architectures, implement integrations, own technical decisions, and deploy production LLM solutions.
cases.reviewReason: Customer-facing role is delivery-led and technically authoritative.

cases.title: Solutions Engineer — AI
cases.descriptionText: Own production AI system architecture, cloud integration, implementation design, and technical decisions for customers.
cases.reviewReason: Solutions role has substantial architecture and implementation authority.

cases.title: Data & AI Architect
cases.descriptionText: Design AI architecture with supporting lakehouse, data modelling, governance, and production ML platform responsibilities.
cases.reviewReason: AI architecture is central while specialist data scope remains a stretch.

cases.title: AI and Data Platform Architect
cases.descriptionText: Own LLM platform architecture plus Snowflake, Databricks, data governance, and production integration decisions.
cases.reviewReason: Architecture is relevant but carries material data-domain requirements.

cases.title: Backend Software Engineer
cases.descriptionText: Implement application features, APIs, unit tests, and maintenance tasks without AI architecture ownership.
cases.reviewReason: Generic software engineering has no AI architecture or technical-leadership scope.

cases.title: Software Engineer
cases.descriptionText: Build web services and resolve tickets under an existing architecture without AI platform decisions.

cases.title: AI Sales Executive
cases.descriptionText: Own revenue quota, sales pipeline, commission targets, and commercial negotiations for AI products.
cases.reviewReason: Quota-led commercial ownership is a hard exclusion.

cases.title: Forward Deployed Architect
cases.descriptionText: Carry sales quota, manage pipeline, present demos, and close commercial deals without implementation authority.
cases.reviewReason: Title does not overcome quota-led, non-technical responsibilities.

cases.title: Building Architect
cases.descriptionText: Produce BIM and Revit models for construction, structural design, and real-estate development.
cases.reviewReason: Construction and BIM responsibilities are outside software architecture.

cases.title: AI Building Architect
cases.descriptionText: Use AI tools for BIM, Revit, construction documentation, and structural building design.
cases.reviewReason: AI wording does not override construction-domain duties.
